name: Dean "Stan" Perkins
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Issaquah, Washington
about: At Dean Standish Perkins & Associates in Issaquah, Washington, Dean "Stan" Perkins leads the charge in advocating for individuals who have suffered due to others' carelessness or negligence. His practice spans the entire state, focusing on personal injury , premises liability , and auto accidents . With 40 years of experience in personal injury law, he has successfully navigated over 10,000 cases since 1986, securing millions for his clients.

Throughout his career, Mr. Perkins has become a well-respected figure in the legal realm, known for his dedication to his clients and relentless pursuit of justice. As his children grew older and his practice thrived, he discovered a new calling – nurturing the next wave of legal talent. He teaches as an adjunct professor at a law school and frequently presents to students, alumni and peers through the Access to Justice Institute. He played a pivotal role to start the Seattle University School of Law’s Incubator program as the benefactor and executive director.

Mr. Perkins is generous with his time, resources and experiences, offering guidance he wished he had received when he first embarked on his own legal journey. He was awarded Mentor of the Year by the King County Bar Association in 2024 and the Apex Award for Innovation by the Washington State Bar Association for his work in the Incubator Mentorship Program through Seattle University School of Law. His commitment to mentoring emerging lawyers is evident as he supports new solo practitioners and those starting their legal careers. He shares his passion and dedication, rooted in his own experiences when he was only a novice in the legal field.

Educationally accomplished, Mr. Perkins earned his B.A. from the University of California, Berkeley, in 1982, followed by his J.D. from Seattle University School of Law in 1985. A pillar in the legal community, he is an active Eagle member of the Washington State Association for Justice and participates in both the Washington State Bar Association (WSBA) and the King County Bar Association.
He finds deep fulfillment in his ability to serve, guide and support individuals through challenging times, cherishing the opportunity to improve his clients' lives through his practice.
